[[File:Yodascrest.svg|thumb|right|175px|Yoda's crest.]]
A '''crest''' was used as a personal symbol by the [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]]. This crest was placed on the door to his [[Yoda's quarters/Legends|quarters]] in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It also seen on some of the furniture within his quarters,<ref name="AotC">{{Film|II}}</ref> carved into some of the exterior walls of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], and on a wing of his [[Yoda's fighter/Legends|personal starfighter]].

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|For Yoda's crest I relied heavily on asian character design. The basis is however very close to the symbol for Feng Shui. ''[sic]''|[[Philip Metschan]]|<ref name="Quote">{{WebCite|url=http://www.principiagraphica.com/portfolio.htm|text=philipmetschan|nolive=yes|archivedate=20150726180747}}</ref>}}
Yoda's crest was designed by conceptual artist [[Philip Metschan]] for [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']].<ref name="Principia">{{WebCite|url=http://www.metschanmedia.com/philip_metschan//portfolio.htm|text=Master Yoda's Crest (slide 8)|work=Principia Graphica (Philip Metschan's Official Site)|archivedate=20171115131603}}</ref> In the [[1994]] novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'', [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] was given a stone box adorned with "the two glyphs that spelled Yoda's name".<ref name="COPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref> The emblem drawn by Metschan also featured two glyphs at the center of the crest.<ref name="Principia" />
